sql:
SELECT rolname, regexp_replace(rolpassword, '(SCRAM-SHA-256)\$(\d+):([a-zA-Z0-9+/=]+)\$([a-zA-Z0-9+=/]+):([a-zA-Z0-9+/=]+)', '\1$\2:<salt>$<storedkey>:<serverkey>') as rolpassword_masked
    FROM pg_authid
    WHERE rolname LIKE 'regress_passwd%'
    ORDER BY rolname, rolpassword
shape: SELECT rolname, regexp_replace(rolpassword, '(SCRAM-SHA-256)\$(\d+):([a-zA-Z0-9+/=]+)\$([a-zA-Z0-9+=/]+):([a-zA-Z0-9+/=]+)', '\1$\2:<salt>$<storedkey>:<serverkey>') AS rolpassword_masked FROM pg_authid WHERE rolname LIKE 'regress_passwd%' ORDER BY rolname, rolpassword;
